privacy.pageDescription: Herb-Era privacy policy — how we collect, use, and protect your personal data
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Herb-Era, we take your privacy seriously. This policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your personal information when you visit our website or make purchases. By using our services, you agree to the practices described below.
privacy.infoCollectContent: We collect personal information you provide directly to us, such as your name, email address, phone number, shipping address, and payment details when you create an account, place an order, or contact our support team. We also automatically collect certain information when you visit our site, including your IP address, browser type, device information, and browsing behavior through cookies and similar technologies.
privacy.infoUseContent: We use your information to process and fulfill your orders, communicate with you about your purchases, send you promotional offers (with your consent), improve our website and product offerings, personalize your shopping experience, prevent fraud and ensure the security of our platform, and comply with legal obligations.
privacy.infoShareContent: We do not sell your personal information to third parties. We may share your data with trusted service providers who assist us in operating our website, processing payments, delivering orders, and sending communications. These partners are contractually obligated to protect your data. We may also disclose information when required by law or to protect our rights.
privacy.cookiesContent: Herb-Era uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your browsing experience, analyze site traffic, and deliver personalized content. You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect certain features of our website.
privacy.dataSecurityContent: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information, including SSL encryption for all data transmissions, secure payment processing through Razorpay, regular security audits, and restricted access to personal data. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.
privacy.thirdPartyContent: Our website uses third-party services including Razorpay for payment processing and Google Analytics for site analytics. These services have their own privacy policies governing data handling. We encourage you to review their policies. We are not responsible for the practices of third-party sites linked from our website.
privacy.yourRightsContent: You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal information at any time through your account dashboard. You may opt out of marketing communications by clicking the unsubscribe link in our emails. For data requests or concerns, please contact us directly. We will respond to your request within 30 days.
privacy.policyUpdatesContent: We may update this privacy policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. We will notify you of material changes by posting the updated policy on this page and updating the 'Last updated' date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.
privacy.contactContent: If you have questions, concerns, or requests regarding this privacy policy or your personal data, please contact us at info@herb-era.com or write to us at Herb-Era Support, India. We are committed to addressing your concerns promptly and transparently.

shipping.pageDescription: Herb-Era shipping policy — delivery timelines, rates, and tracking information
shipping.heading: Shipping Policy
shipping.intro: At Herb-Era, we strive to deliver your orders promptly and safely. This Shipping Policy outlines our shipping practices, timelines, and charges.
shipping.processingContent: Orders are processed within 1-2 business days after payment confirmation. Orders placed on weekends or public holidays will be processed on the next business day. You will receive a confirmation email once your order is shipped.
shipping.ratesContent: We offer free standard shipping on orders above ₹500. Standard shipping is charged at a flat rate of ₹49 for orders below ₹500. Express shipping is available at ₹99 for metro cities and ₹149 for other locations.
shipping.timelineContent: Standard shipping delivers within 5-7 business days across India. Express shipping delivers within 2-3 business days. Delivery times may vary depending on remote locations, weather conditions, or unforeseen circumstances.
shipping.trackingContent: Once your order is shipped, you will receive a tracking number via email and SMS. You can track your order in real-time through your account dashboard or our order tracking page.
shipping.internationalContent: Currently, Herb-Era ships only within India. We are working to expand our international shipping capabilities and will update our customers as soon as this becomes available.
shipping.addressContent: Please ensure your shipping address is correct at checkout. If you need to change your address after placing an order, contact us immediately at info@herb-era.com. We cannot guarantee address changes once the order has been shipped.
shipping.contactContent: For shipping-related inquiries, please contact us at info@herb-era.com or call our support line.

returns.pageDescription: Herb-Era return and refund policy — eligibility, process, and timelines
returns.heading: Return & Refund Policy
returns.intro: We want you to be completely satisfied with your Herb-Era purchase. If you are not happy with your order, this policy outlines your options for returns and refunds.
returns.eligibilityContent: To be eligible for a return, items must be unused, unopened, and in their original packaging. Products must be returned within the specified return window. Certain products, including personalized or perishable items, are not eligible for return.
returns.windowContent: You may request a return within 7 days of delivery. Returns requested after this period will not be accepted. Please initiate your return as soon as possible to ensure smooth processing.
returns.processContent: To initiate a return, log into your account, go to your orders page, and click 'Request Return'. Alternatively, contact our support team at info@herb-era.com. Once your return is approved, you will receive instructions for shipping the item back to us.
returns.refundsContent: Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after we receive and inspect the returned item. The refund will be credited to your original payment method. Shipping charges are non-refundable unless the return is due to our error or a defective product.
returns.exchangesContent: We offer exchanges for damaged, defective, or incorrect items. Please contact us within 48 hours of delivery with photos of the issue. We will arrange a replacement at no additional cost.
returns.nonReturnableContent: For hygiene and safety reasons, certain items cannot be returned once opened. This includes consumable products like herbal powders, oils, and supplements. Please check the product page for specific return eligibility before purchasing.
returns.contactContent: For return and refund queries, please contact us at info@herb-era.com.

cancellation.pageDescription: Herb-Era cancellation policy — how to cancel or modify your order
cancellation.heading: Cancellation Policy
cancellation.intro: We understand that plans can change. This policy explains how you can cancel or modify your order with Herb-Era.
cancellation.orderContent: Orders can be cancelled within 24 hours of placement without any charges. After 24 hours, if the order has not been shipped, a cancellation fee of 10% of the order value may apply. Once the order has been shipped, it cannot be cancelled.
cancellation.modificationContent: To modify your order (change address, add items, etc.), please contact us immediately at info@herb-era.com. We will do our best to accommodate changes if the order has not yet been processed for shipping.
cancellation.refundsContent: If your order is cancelled before shipping, a full refund minus any applicable cancellation fees will be processed within 3-5 business days to your original payment method.
cancellation.contactContent: For cancellation or modification requests, please email us at info@herb-era.com.

cookiePolicy.pageDescription: Herb-Era cookie policy — how we use cookies and tracking technologies
cookiePolicy.heading: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.intro: Herb-Era uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your browsing experience, analyze site traffic, and deliver personalized content. This policy explains what cookies are, how we use them, and your choices.
cookiePolicy.whatAreContent: Cookies are small text files stored on your device by your web browser when you visit a website. They help the website remember your preferences, login status, and other information to improve your experience.
cookiePolicy.howWeUseContent: We use cookies to remember your preferences (language, theme), keep you logged in, analyze how you use our site, and deliver relevant advertisements. Some cookies are essential for the website to function properly.
cookiePolicy.essentialContent: These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be disabled. They enable core functionality such as security, network management, and account access. The website may not work properly without these cookies.
cookiePolicy.analyticsContent: We use analytics cookies to understand how visitors interact with our website, which pages are most popular, and how users navigate our site. This helps us improve your experience and optimize our content.
cookiePolicy.functionalContent: Functional cookies allow the website to remember your choices (such as your language preference, currency, or region) and provide enhanced, personalized features.
cookiePolicy.targetingContent: These cookies may be set through our site by advertising partners. They build a profile of your interests and show you relevant ads on other sites. They do not store personal information directly.
cookiePolicy.manageContent: You can control and manage cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to block or delete cookies. Please note that disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of our website.
cookiePolicy.thirdPartyContent: Some third-party services we use — such as Google Analytics and payment processors — may set their own cookies on your device. We do not control these cookies. Please refer to the respective third-party privacy policies for details.
cookiePolicy.updatesContent: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.
cookiePolicy.contactContent: If you have questions about our Cookie Policy, please contact us at info@herb-era.com.

faqPage.pageDescription: Herb-Era FAQ — answers to common questions about ordering, shipping, returns, and products
faqPage.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faqPage.intro: Find answers to common questions about Herb-Era products, orders, shipping, and more.
faqPage.ordersQ1: How do I place an order?
faqPage.ordersA1: Simply browse our products, add items to your cart, and proceed to checkout. You can create an account or checkout as a guest.
faqPage.ordersQ2: Can I modify my order after placing it?
faqPage.ordersA2: Contact us within 24 hours of placing your order and we will try to accommodate changes. After that, modifications may not be possible.
faqPage.ordersQ3: Will I receive an order confirmation?
faqPage.ordersA3: Yes, you will receive an email confirmation immediately after placing your order.
faqPage.ordersQ4: How can I track my order?
faqPage.ordersA4: Once shipped, you will receive a tracking number via email and SMS. You can also track it from your account dashboard.
faqPage.shippingA1: Standard shipping takes 5-7 business days. Express shipping delivers within 2-3 business days.
faqPage.shippingA2: Yes, we offer free standard shipping on all orders above ₹500.
faqPage.shippingA3: Currently we ship only within India. We are working on expanding internationally.
faqPage.shippingQ4: What if my order is delayed?
faqPage.shippingA4: If your order is significantly delayed, please contact our support team and we will investigate.
faqPage.returnsA1: You can return items within 7 days of delivery. Items must be unused and in original packaging.
faqPage.returnsA2: Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after we receive the returned item.
faqPage.returnsA3: Yes, we offer exchanges for damaged, defective, or incorrect items. Contact us within 48 hours of delivery.
faqPage.returnsA4: Shipping charges are non-refundable unless the return is due to our error or a defective product.
faqPage.paymentQ1: What payment methods do you accept?
faqPage.paymentA1: We accept credit/debit cards, UPI, net banking, and wallets through our secure Razorpay payment gateway.
faqPage.paymentA2: Yes, all payments are processed through Razorpay's secure, PCI-DSS compliant platform. We do not store your payment details.
faqPage.paymentQ3: Do you offer Cash on Delivery?
faqPage.paymentA3: Cash on Delivery is available for select pincodes. The option will appear at checkout if available for your address.
faqPage.paymentQ4: Can I use a coupon code?
faqPage.paymentA4: Yes, you can enter your coupon code at checkout. Only one coupon can be used per order.
faqPage.productsQ1: Are your products authentic Ayurvedic formulations?
faqPage.productsA1: Yes, our products are crafted following traditional Ayurvedic principles using authentic herbs and natural ingredients.
faqPage.productsQ2: Do your products have side effects?
faqPage.productsA2: Our products are made from natural ingredients and are generally safe. However, we recommend consulting a healthcare professional before use. Each product page lists any known side effects.
faqPage.productsQ3: What is the shelf life of your products?
faqPage.productsA3: Most of our products have a shelf life of 24 to 36 months from the date of manufacture. Check the product packaging for the exact expiry date.
faqPage.productsQ4: Are your products tested for quality?
faqPage.productsA4: Yes, all Herb-Era products undergo rigorous quality testing in our manufacturing facilities to ensure purity, potency, and safety.
faqPage.accountQ1: How do I create an account?
faqPage.accountA1: Click on the 'Sign Up' button in the top navigation bar and fill in your details. You can also create an account during checkout.
faqPage.accountQ2: How do I reset my password?
faqPage.accountA2: Click on 'Forgot Password' on the sign-in page and follow the instructions sent to your email.
faqPage.accountA3: Yes, you can request account deletion by contacting our support team. Your data will be removed within 30 days.
faqPage.accountQ4: How do I update my profile?
faqPage.accountA4: Log into your account and navigate to the profile section to update your personal information and preferences.
faqPage.generalQ1: How can I contact customer support?
faqPage.generalA1: You can reach us via email at info@herb-era.com, or through the contact form on our website.
faqPage.generalA2: Our support team is available Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM IST.
faqPage.generalQ3: Do you have a physical store?
faqPage.generalA3: Herb-Era currently operates as an online-only store. We do not have physical retail locations.
faqPage.generalA4: We welcome product suggestions! Please reach out to us with your ideas and we will consider them.
